 Job Overview: We are seeking a creative and detail-oriented Content Writer to join our team. This role involves extensive research and crafting unique, SEO-friendly content that engages our target audience, enhances brand awareness, and supports our marketing goals. The ideal candidate should be skilled in creating various forms of written content, from blog posts to product descriptions, while effectively communicating our brand's message and values 
 Job Responsibilities: Perform extensive study on industry-related subjects, research and draft innovative, unique blogs/articles adhering to SEO guidelines. Create content pieces that appeal to our audience, attract customers, and boost our brand awareness. Compose product descriptions to promote our products and services. Draft or proofread any type of content beyond SEO as required by the organization. 
 Basic Skills Required: Experience in writing articles/blogs, web content, copy writing and product descriptions. Familiarity with keyword placement and other SEO best practices. An understanding of formatting content for SEO, Websites & Social Media. Experience and interest in general writing beyond SEO. 
 Core Skills: Strong Communication Skills (English) Excellent Interpersonal Skills Strategic Thinking Analytical Skills Eye for Detail 
 Other Essential Skills Creative, Confident, and Reliable Takes Initiative Team Player Multi-Tasker Handles Tight Deadlines & Target Oriented 
 Tools of the Trade: High comprehension of software's like Microsoft Word and Google Docs Content Management Software, such as WordPress (preferable, not mandatory) Slideshow Software, such as Microsoft PowerPoint Education and other requirements: Bachelors/Masters Degree, preferably in English or Journalism with a minimum of 2-3 years of experience in blog /article writing Excellent drafting, editing, and proofreading skills Impeccable spelling and grammar Computer & Internet Savvy

Key Skills: Proof reading,Writing,Time,Content writing,Content,Content creation,Content strategy,Wfo
